main_text.p: רקם רִקְמָה Ch.Pictura acus,Ezech.27.16. Pictura vel Maculae pardi,Jerem.13.22.
רִקָּם Ch.Nomen proprium loci, Hebr. קרש.

רקן רוקן Ch.Eruit,eripuit,liberavit: Vomuit, evomuit:Effudit,deplevit,evacuavit:Spoliavit,abripuit, Gen.31.16. Jon. & Exod.12.36. Foemin. רוקנרת Lev.18.25. Sic etiam legendum Genef.24.20. in T. Jon. pro לוקינת. Ithpahel Praet. ואתרוקנו Et spoliaverunt se, exuti sunt, Exo.33.6. in Jon. Sic Cantic.2.17. Verbum hoc ortum est ex ריק, אריק.
רקע Syr. Expandere, Hebr. רקע. Hinc Mensura expansa, ampla, Lucae 6.38. Ex Pahel Part. מסנן בלן ומרקעין Calceos veteres & resartos, Jos.9.5.
Syr. Assumentum, panniculus, qui vestimento trito inditur ad scissuram explendam, quod eidem quasi infarciatur, seu inculcetur, Graec. Ῥαῖσμα.
רקיעא רקיע Ch. Expansum, Coelum aut firmamentum expansum. Vide de hac voce Nic.Full.in Miscell.lib. 1.c.6. Plur. כזיו רקיעין Sicut splendor firmamentorum, Num.24.6. in T. Jon.
רקוע רקוע Ch.Maculosum,Maculis respersum. Plural. רקועין. Foemin. רקועתא Genef.30.35.39.
רקיעא Ch.Pulvillus:vel Cervical,ut alii. Plu. רקיעי, רקיעין Pulvilli,Ezech.13.18.20. Resp.Hebr. נסתורת.

page.notes: Greek word in the entry "Graec." is partly illegible and rendered approximately; Hebrew and Syriac forms are transcribed from the scan and may contain small errors. Marginal ink mark near "Graec." is a stain, not text.
